props.gloss_en: from the New Moon of Nisan until its eighth the tamid was established -- not to eulogize on them
from its eighth until the end of the festival the festival of Shavuot was restored -- not to eulogize on them
Rav: [the mention of the New Moon] is needed only to forbid the day before it
the New Moon is Torah law
and Torah law needs no reinforcement
the days written in Megillat Taanit -- before them and after them are forbidden
Shabbatot and festivals -- they are forbidden, before them and after them are permitted
and what is the difference between them? these are words of Torah, and words of Torah need no reinforcement
these are words of the scribes, and words of the scribes need reinforcement
Rav Pappa: as Rav said [of the New Moon], here too [the mention of the festival's end] is needed only to forbid the day after it
whose view is this? R' Yosei's
R' Yosei, who said: both before it and after it are forbidden
on the twenty-eighth of it [Adar] good tidings came to the Jews, that they would not be removed from the Torah

once the wicked kingdom decreed persecution on Israel: not to occupy themselves with Torah, not to circumcise their sons, and to desecrate Shabbatot; Yehuda ben Shammua and his companions went and took counsel from a matron whom all the great of Rome frequented
she said to them: arise and cry out at night
O Heavens! are we not brothers, are we not sons of one father, are we not sons of one mother? how are we different from every nation and tongue, that you decree evil decrees upon us!
and they annulled them, and that day they made a holiday
Abaye: [the mention of the New Moon] is needed only for a full month
Rav Ashi: [even a deficient month --] every day after it: in fasting, forbidden
in eulogy, permitted
and this one [the 29th], since it lies between two holidays, they made it like a holiday itself, and even eulogy is forbidden
since, were something to occur and they annulled the seven, the eighth itself is forbidden, being the first day on which the festival of Shavuot was restored

now that you have come to this, the twenty-ninth too: since, were something to occur and they annulled the twenty-eighth, the twenty-ninth itself is forbidden, being the day before the day the tamid was established
Rav Chiyya bar Asi said in Rav's name: the halakha follows R' Yosei
and Shmuel said: the halakha follows R' Meir
Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel: why does it say 'on them', 'on them' twice? to tell you that they are forbidden, and before them and after them are permitted
and Shmuel said: the halakha follows Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel

at first he held: since there is no tanna as lenient as R' Meir, he said the halakha follows R' Meir; once he heard that Rabban Shimon is more lenient, he said the halakha follows Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel
and likewise Bali said in the name of R' Chiyya bar Abba in the name of R' Yochanan: the halakha follows R' Yosei
R' Chiyya said to Bali: I will explain it to you -- when R' Yochanan said the halakha follows R' Yosei, [he said it] of 'not to fast'
but R' Yochanan said: the halakha follows an anonymous mishnah
though they said one reads earlier and not later, [the days of early reading] are permitted for eulogy and fasting
if you say [it speaks of] those of the fifteenth who read it on the fourteenth
rather, those of the fourteenth who read it on the thirteenth
those of the fourteenth who read it on the twelfth
rather, is it not where they read it on the eleventh, and it teaches: permitted for eulogy and fasting
but it is written in Megillat Taanit: the fourteenth day of it and the fifteenth day of it are the days of Purim, not to eulogize on them
and Rava said: it is needed only to forbid the [day] of these on those and the [day] of those on these
Trajan's Day itself they annulled, since Shemaya and Achiya his brother were killed on it
Rav Nachman decreed a fast on the twelfth
he said to them: Trajan's Day itself they annulled, since Shemaya and Achiya his brother were killed on it

Nicanor was one of the Greek governors; every day he would wave his hand over Judea and Jerusalem and say: when will it fall into my hand and I trample it; when the Hasmonean kingdom prevailed and defeated them, they cut off his thumbs and big toes and hung them on the gates of Jerusalem
and they said: the mouth that spoke in pride and the hands that waved over Jerusalem -- let vengeance be done on them
if you are of the people of Chananya, Mishael and Azarya, let your God come and save you from my hand as He saved Chananya, Mishael and Azarya from the hand of Nebuchadnezzar
Chananya, Mishael and Azarya were wholly righteous and worthy that a miracle be done for them, and Nebuchadnezzar was a fitting king, fit that a miracle be done through him
and that wicked one is a commoner, not fit that a miracle be done through him

and we have incurred destruction before the Omnipresent; if you do not kill us He has many killers, many bears and lions; the Holy One, blessed be He, delivered us into your hand only because He will exact our blood from your hand
even so he killed them at once; they said: they had not moved from there before officials came from Rome and split his skull with clubs

objections.gloss_en: ושלפניו נמי, תיפוק ליה דהוה ליה יום שלפני ראש חדש! -- the day before too: derive it from its being the day before the New Moon

answered_by.gloss_en: ראש חדש דאורייתא הוא, ודאורייתא לא בעי חיזוק (= p_rosh_chodesh_deoraita, p_deoraita_ein_chizuk)

objections.gloss_en: אי הכי בעשרים ותשעה נמי -- מאי איריא דהוי יומא דמקמי יומא דמיתוקם תמידא? תיפוק ליה דהוה ליה יומא דבתר עשרין ותמניא ביה! דתניא: בעשרים ותמניא ביה אתת בשורתא טבתא...

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר אביי: לא נצרכה אלא לחדש מעובר (= p_abaye_meubar)
רב אשי אמר: אפילו תימא לחודש חסר, כל שלאחריו בתענית אסור בהספד מותר, וזה הואיל ומוטל בין שני ימים טובים עשאוהו כיום טוב עצמו (= p_rav_ashi_*)
השתא דאתית להכי, עשרים ותשעה נמי: were the 28th annulled, the 29th itself is forbidden as the day before the tamid day (= p_esrim_vetisha_gufei_asur)

objections.gloss_en: ומי אמר שמואל הכי? והתניא, רבן שמעון בן גמליאל אומר: ... לפניהן ולאחריהן מותרין, ואמר שמואל: הלכה כרבן שמעון בן גמליאל

answered_by.gloss_en: מעיקרא סבר: כיון דליכא תנא דמיקל כרבי מאיר אמר הלכה כרבי מאיר; כיון דשמעיה לרבן שמעון דמיקל טפי, אמר הלכה כרבן שמעון בן גמליאל (= p_ein_tanna_meikel_krmeir)

objections.gloss_en: ומי אמר רבי יוחנן הכי? והאמר רבי יוחנן הלכה כסתם משנה, ותנן: ...מותרין בהספד ותענית -- read (via f_eimat) of those reading on the eleventh, the day before Trajan's Day, it permits fasting on a day before a Megillat Taanit day

answered_by.gloss_en: לא, בני ארבעה עשר וקא קרו ליה בתריסר, ודקאמרת יום טוריינוס הוא -- יום טוריינוס גופיה בטולי בטלוהו (= p_alt_bnei_arbeisar_bitreisar, p_turyanus_batel)

objections.gloss_en: ותיפוק ליה דהוה ליה יום שלפני ניקנור! -- even with Trajan's Day annulled, the twelfth is the day before Nicanor's Day

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר רב אשי: השתא איהו גופיה בטלוה, משום יום ניקנור ניקום וניגזר?

objections.gloss_en: אמרו ליה רבנן: יום טוריינוס הוא!

answered_by.gloss_en: אמר להו: יום טוריינוס גופיה בטולי בטלוהו, הואיל ונהרגו בו שמעיה ואחיה אחיו (= p_rav_nachman_turyanus_batel)
